source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 10 (PDF 212-243), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 10 (Electrochemistry) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Electrochemistry is the branch of chemistry which deals with:
(Electrochemistry chemistry ki woh shakh hai jo kis cheez se mutalliq hai?)

options.text: sirf heat ko roshni mein badalna
bijli aur chemical energy ka aapas mein tabdeel hona

blocks.explanation: Electrochemistry bijli ki energy aur chemical energy ke aapas mein tabdeel hone se mutalliq hai (10.1).

book_ref.quote: deals with inter conversion of electrical and chemical energy

blocks.prompt:
2 Oxidation is a process involving:
(Oxidation aisa process hai jis mein:)

options.text: electron ya electrons ka kho dena

blocks.explanation: Oxidation mein electron ya electrons kho diye jate hain (10.1).

book_ref.quote: Oxidation is a process involving loss of electron or electrons.

blocks.prompt:
3 In the change Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu, the copper ion is:
(Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu tabdeeli mein copper ion ke saath kya hota hai?)

options.text: oxidize hota hai, kyunke electrons hasil karta hai
oxidize hota hai, kyunke electrons khota hai
reduce hota hai, kyunke electrons hasil karta hai
na oxidize hota hai na reduce

blocks.explanation: Cu²⁺ do electrons hasil karta hai; electrons hasil karna reduction hai (10.1).

book_ref.quote: In these examples, Cl⁰ and Cu⁺² have gained electrons; therefore, they are reduced.

blocks.prompt:
4 The correct half-equation for the oxidation of a zinc atom is:
(Zinc atom ki oxidation ki durust half-equation kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zinc atom do electrons kho kar Zn²⁺ banta hai; sirf Zn → Zn²⁺ + 2e⁻ mein charges barabar hain (10.1, book correction).

book_ref.quote: The book prints Zn⁰ → Zn⁺² + e⁻. A zinc atom loses two electrons

blocks.prompt:
5 Reactions in which oxidation and reduction take place together are called:
(Woh reactions jin mein oxidation aur reduction aik saath hote hain, kya kehlati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Oxidation aur reduction hamesha aik saath hote hain; aisi reactions redox reactions kehlati hain (10.1).

book_ref.quote: Oxidation and reduction always take place together.

blocks.prompt:
6 Which pair of everyday processes are both redox reactions?
(Rozmarra ke kaun se do processes dono redox reactions hain?)
blocks.explanation: Photosynthesis (zia ke zariye khoraak banana) aur respiration (saans/tanaffus) dono redox reactions hain (10.1).

book_ref.quote: Photosynthesis is a redox reaction which provides food for the entire planet

blocks.prompt:
7 Oxidation number of an atom in a molecule or ion is best described as its:
(Molecule ya ion mein atom ka oxidation number kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oxidation number molecule ya ion mein kisi element ke atom par zahiri (apparent) charge hai (10.2).

book_ref.quote: It is the apparent charge on an atom (per atom) of an element in a molecule or an ion.

blocks.prompt:
8 An atom with a higher positive oxidation number is:
(Zyada positive oxidation number wala atom:)
blocks.explanation: Zyada positive oxidation number ka matlab hai atom ya ion zyada oxidize hua hai (10.2).

book_ref.quote: Higher positive oxidation numbers mean that an atom or ion is more oxidized.

blocks.prompt:
9 The oxidation number of each sulfur atom in S₈ is:
(S₈ mein har sulfur atom ka oxidation number kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kisi bhi uncombined (akele) element ka oxidation number zero hota hai, maslan S₈ ka har atom (10.2.1).

book_ref.quote: the oxidation number of each atom in S₈, H₂, Cl₂, Na, Mg and Zn is zero

blocks.prompt:
10 The oxidation number of hydrogen in sodium hydride, NaH, is:
(Sodium hydride (NaH) mein hydrogen ka oxidation number kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen +1 hota hai magar metal hydrides jaise NaH mein −1 hota hai (10.2.1).

book_ref.quote: hydrogen is +1 (except in metal hydrides, such as NaH, where it is –1)

blocks.prompt:
11 The oxidation number of oxygen in F₂O is:
(F₂O mein oxygen ka oxidation number kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oxygen −2 hota hai siwaye peroxides (−1) aur F₂O ke, jahan yeh +2 hai (10.2.1).

book_ref.quote: oxygen is –2 (except in peroxides, where it is –1, and in F₂O, where it is +2)

blocks.prompt:
12 The oxidation number of oxygen in KO₂ is:
(KO₂ mein oxygen ka oxidation number kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oxygen H₂O, Na₂O₂ aur KO₂ mein tarteeb se −2, −1 aur −1/2 dikhati hai (10.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Oxygen shows -2, -1 and -1/2 in H₂O, Na₂O₂, and KO₂ respectively.

blocks.prompt:
13 The oxidation number of aluminium in the Al³⁺ ion is:
(Al³⁺ ion mein aluminium ka oxidation number kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mono-atomic (aik atom wale) ion mein oxidation number ion ke charge ke barabar hota hai; Al³⁺ ka +3 hai (10.2.1).

book_ref.quote: The oxidation number of an element in a mono-atomic ion is always the same as the charge on the ion

blocks.prompt:
14 In a polyatomic ion, the algebraic sum of the oxidation numbers of all atoms is equal to:
(Kai atoms wale ion mein tamam atoms ke oxidation numbers ka algebraic majmua kis ke barabar hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ions mein oxidation numbers ka algebraic majmua ion ke charge ke barabar hota hai (10.2.1).

book_ref.quote: In ions, the algebraic sum of oxidation number equals the charge on the ion.

blocks.prompt:
15 In a compound or ion, the negative oxidation number is given to the element that is:
(Compound ya ion mein negative oxidation number us element ko diya jata hai jo:)
blocks.explanation: Zyada electronegative element ko negative oxidation number diya jata hai, maslan HF mein fluorine −1 hai (10.2.1).

book_ref.quote: the more electronegative element is given the negative oxidation number

blocks.prompt:
16 The oxidation number of sulfur in H₂SO₄ is:
(H₂SO₄ mein sulfur ka oxidation number kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2(+1) + S + 4(−2) = 0, is liye S = +6 (10.2.1 ke usool, Sample Problem 10.2 ki tarah).

book_ref.quote: Compound ions are ions with two or more different atoms.

blocks.prompt:
17 The oxidation number of nitrogen in the nitrate ion, NO₃⁻, is:
(Nitrate ion (NO₃⁻) mein nitrogen ka oxidation number kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: N + 3(−2) = −1, is liye N = −1 + 6 = +5 (compound ions).

book_ref.quote: Examples are the sulfate ion, SO₄²⁻, and the nitrate ion, NO₃⁻.

blocks.prompt:
18 The oxidation number of manganese in MnO₂ is:
(MnO₂ mein manganese ka oxidation number kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mn + 2(−2) = 0, is liye Mn = +4 (Sample Problem 10.3 wala tareeqa).

book_ref.quote: Calculate the oxidation number (Ox. No.) of manganese in KMnO₄.

blocks.prompt:
19 The oxidation number of phosphorus in the phosphate ion, PO₄³⁻, is:
(Phosphate ion (PO₄³⁻) mein phosphorus ka oxidation number kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: P + 4(−2) = −3, is liye P = −3 + 8 = +5 (compound ions).

book_ref.quote: Calculate the oxidation number (Ox. No.) of sulphur in SO₄²⁻.

blocks.prompt:
20 In potassium sulfide, K₂S, the oxidation number of sulfur is:
(Potassium sulfide (K₂S) mein sulfur ka oxidation number kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Metal positive hota hai: 2(+1) + S = 0, is liye S = −2 (10.2.2).

book_ref.quote: A metal always has the positive Ox. No. and nonmetals have the negative Ox. state

blocks.prompt:
21 In a compound of two different non-metals, the sign of each oxidation number depends on:
(Do mukhtalif non-metals ke compound mein oxidation number ka sign kis par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Do mukhtalif non-metals wale compounds mein sign electronegativity par munhasir hai; sab se zyada electronegative element ko negative sign milta hai (10.2.2).

book_ref.quote: the sign of the Ox. No. depends on the electronegativity of each atom

blocks.prompt:
22 The oxidation number of carbon in carbon dioxide, CO₂, is:
(Carbon dioxide (CO₂) mein carbon ka oxidation number kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: C + 2(−2) = 0, is liye C = +4 (Sample Problem 10.1 wala tareeqa).

book_ref.quote: Find the oxidation No. of S in Sulfur dioxide, SO₂.

blocks.prompt:
23 A reaction in which a single substance acts as both the oxidizing and reducing agent is called:
(Woh reaction jis mein aik hi substance oxidizing aur reducing agent dono ka kaam kare, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh disproportionation reaction ki taareef hai (10.3).

book_ref.quote: a single substance acts as both the oxidizing and reducing agent

blocks.prompt:
24 In the decomposition 2H₂O₂ → 2H₂O + O₂, the oxidation number of oxygen changes from −1 to:
(2H₂O₂ → 2H₂O + O₂ mein oxygen ka oxidation number −1 se kis mein badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oxygen −1 se −2 (H₂O) mein reduce aur −1 se 0 (O₂) mein oxidize hoti hai; product pani hai, H₂O₂ nahi (10.3, book correction).

book_ref.quote: Oxidation number of oxygen in H₂O₂ = -1

blocks.prompt:
25 In 6NaOH + 3Cl₂ → 5NaCl + NaClO₃ + 3H₂O, the oxidation number of chlorine in NaClO₃ is:
(6NaOH + 3Cl₂ → 5NaCl + NaClO₃ + 3H₂O mein NaClO₃ ke andar chlorine ka oxidation number kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: +1 + Cl + 3(−2) = 0 se Cl = +5; chlorine 0 se +5 tak oxidize hoti hai (10.3).

book_ref.quote: Oxidation number of chlorine in NaClO₃ = +5 (Cl is oxidized from 0 to +5)

blocks.prompt:
26 Disproportionation can occur only for an element that:
(Disproportionation sirf us element mein ho sakta hai jo:)

options.text: sirf aik oxidation state rakhta ho
kai oxidation states mein reh sakta ho

blocks.explanation: Disproportionation wahan hota hai jahan ions ya molecules kai oxidation states mein reh sakte hon (10.3).

book_ref.quote: Disproportionation reactions can occur where ions or molecules can exist in multiple oxidation states

blocks.prompt:
27 An oxidizing agent is a substance which:
(Oxidizing agent woh substance hai jo:)

options.text: electrons kho kar khud oxidize hota hai
na electrons leta hai na deta hai
hamesha apna oxidation number barhata hai
electrons hasil kar ke khud reduce hota hai

blocks.explanation: Oxidizing agent doosre ko oxidize karta hai aur khud electrons hasil kar ke kam oxidation state mein reduce hota hai (10.4).

book_ref.quote: is itself reduced to a lower oxidation state by gaining one or more electrons

blocks.prompt:
28 In the change Na → Na⁺ + e⁻, sodium acts as:
(Na → Na⁺ + e⁻ tabdeeli mein sodium kya kaam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sodium electron deta hai aur zyada oxidation state hasil karta hai, is liye reducing agent hai (10.4).

book_ref.quote: since it is providing electrons, it gets higher oxidation state

blocks.prompt:
29 When an element X gains an electron to become X⁻, its oxidation number:
(Jab element X aik electron hasil kar ke X⁻ banta hai to us ka oxidation number:)
blocks.explanation: X electron kheenchta hai, is liye oxidizing agent hai aur us ka oxidation number 0 se −1 ho jata hai (10.4).

book_ref.quote: the element M is said to be acting as an oxidizing agent, since it withdraws an electron

blocks.text: 10.5 Balancing redox equations by the oxidation number method

blocks.prompt:
30 In the oxidation number method, after writing the skeleton equation, the next step is to:
(Oxidation number method mein skeleton equation likhne ke baad agla qadam kya hai?)

options.text: un elements ki pehchan jin ka oxidation number badalta hai
har formula ko do se zarb dena

blocks.explanation: Doosra qadam un elements ki pehchan hai jin ka oxidation number badalta hai (10.5).

book_ref.quote: Identify the elements, which undergo a change in their oxidation number during the reaction.

blocks.prompt:
31 In the oxidation number method, the total increase in oxidation number is made equal to the total decrease by:
(Oxidation number method mein oxidation number ka kul izafa kul kami ke barabar kaise kiya jata hai?)

options.text: munasib adad se zarb de kar

blocks.explanation: Izafa aur kami (khoye aur hasil kiye electrons) ko munasib adad se zarb de kar barabar kiya jata hai (10.5).

book_ref.quote: Equate the increase or decrease in the oxidation number

blocks.prompt:
32 In the inspection (hit and trial) method, the atoms balanced last are those of:
(Inspection (hit and trial) method mein sab se aakhir mein kis element ke atoms barabar kiye jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Tarteeb: pehle N, O aur H ke ilawa sab, phir nitrogen, phir oxygen, aur aakhir mein hydrogen (10.5, Did you know).

book_ref.quote: Firstly, balance atoms of all elements except nitrogen, oxygen and hydrogen.

blocks.prompt:
33 In K₂Cr₂O₇ + HCl → KCl + CrCl₃ + Cl₂ + H₂O, the total decrease in the oxidation number of chromium per K₂Cr₂O₇ is:
(K₂Cr₂O₇ + HCl → KCl + CrCl₃ + Cl₂ + H₂O mein aik K₂Cr₂O₇ ke liye chromium ke oxidation number mein kul kami kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har Cr +6 se +3 hota hai (3 units); do Cr atoms se aik K₂Cr₂O₇ ke liye 6 units (Sample Problem 10.4).

book_ref.quote: Decrease in Ox. No. of Cr is 6 units for one molecule of K₂Cr₂O₇.

blocks.prompt:
34 In the balanced equation K₂Cr₂O₇ + xHCl → 2KCl + 2CrCl₃ + 3Cl₂ + 7H₂O, the value of x is:
(Balanced equation K₂Cr₂O₇ + xHCl → 2KCl + 2CrCl₃ + 3Cl₂ + 7H₂O mein x ki qeemat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Daayen taraf chlorine = 2 + 6 + 6 = 14, is liye 14 HCl chahiye (Sample Problem 10.4).

book_ref.quote: Hence, the balanced equation is, K₂Cr₂O₇ + 14HCl → 2KCl + 2CrCl₃ + 3Cl₂ + 7H₂O

blocks.prompt:
35 In the reaction of K₂Cr₂O₇ with HCl to give Cl₂, the reducing agent is:
(K₂Cr₂O₇ aur HCl ke reaction mein (jis se Cl₂ banti hai) reducing agent kaun hai?)

options.text: HCl (Cl⁻ oxidize ho kar Cl₂ banta hai)

blocks.explanation: Cl −1 se 0 hota hai aur oxidize hota hai, is liye HCl reducing agent hai; Cr (+6 → +3) oxidizing agent hai (Sample Problem 10.4).

book_ref.quote: Cr undergoes a change in oxidation state from +6 to +3 and it is reduced

blocks.prompt:
36 When an element in a species both increases and decreases its oxidation number (disproportionation), the species is written while balancing:
(Jab kisi species ka element apna oxidation number barhaye bhi aur ghataye bhi (disproportionation), to balance karte waqt woh species:)

options.text: equation se nikal di jati hai

blocks.explanation: Kitab ki misalon (Cl₂ + NaOH + Cl₂, HNO₃ + Cu + HNO₃) mein woh species baayen (reactant) taraf do dafa likhi jati hai (10.5, book correction).

book_ref.quote: The species containing such element is written twice on the RHS of the equation.

blocks.prompt:
37 An electrolytic cell converts:
(Electrolytic cell kis energy ko kis mein badalta hai?)

options.text: chemical energy ko bijli ki energy mein
bijli ki energy ko chemical energy mein
roshni ki energy ko bijli mein

blocks.explanation: Electrolytic cell electrolysis ke zariye bijli ki energy ko chemical energy mein badalta hai (10.6).

book_ref.quote: converts electrical energy into chemical energy through a process called electrolysis

blocks.prompt:
38 In an electrolytic cell, the anode is the:
(Electrolytic cell mein anode kaun sa electrode hai?)

options.text: woh electrode jahan reduction hoti hai

blocks.explanation: Electrolysis cell mein anode positive aur cathode negative electrode hai (10.6).

book_ref.quote: the anode is the positive electrode – the cathode is the negative electrode

blocks.prompt:
39 The power supply used for electrolysis must be:
(Electrolysis ke liye power supply kaisi honi chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Electrolysis cell ki power supply direct current (DC) honi chahiye (10.6).

book_ref.quote: the power supply must be direct current.

blocks.prompt:
40 The electrolyte in an electrolysis cell is:
(Electrolysis cell mein electrolyte kya hota hai?)

options.text: pighla hua ionic compound ya ions ka gaarha aqueous solution

blocks.explanation: Electrolyte woh compound hai jo toot-ta hai; yeh pighla hua ionic compound ya ions ka gaarha aqueous solution hota hai (10.6).

book_ref.quote: it is either a molten ionic compound or a concentrated aqueous solution of ions

blocks.prompt:
41 In an electrolytic cell, positive ions move towards the:
(Electrolytic cell mein positive ions kis taraf jate hain?)

options.text: anode ki taraf, jahan oxidize hote hain
cathode ki taraf, jahan reduce hote hain
cathode ki taraf, jahan oxidize hote hain
anode ki taraf, jahan reduce hote hain

blocks.explanation: Positive ions cathode ki taraf jate hain jahan woh electrons hasil karte hain (reduction) (10.6).

book_ref.quote: positive ions in the electrolyte migrate towards the cathode, where they gain electrons

blocks.prompt:
42 Which of the following is NOT a use of electrolytic cells mentioned in the chapter?
(In mein se kaun sa electrolytic cells ka istemal chapter mein bayan nahi hua?)
blocks.explanation: Electrolytic cells metals ki safai aur plating, caustic soda aur chlorine banane mein istemal hote hain; dhoop ko bijli mein badalna photovoltaic cell ka kaam hai (10.6, 10.22).

book_ref.quote: the production of chemicals like caustic soda

blocks.prompt:
43 During electrolysis, reduction always occurs at the:
(Electrolysis ke dauran reduction hamesha kahan hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Electrons hasil karna reduction hai aur yeh hamesha cathode par hoti hai (10.7).

book_ref.quote: Gain of electrons is reduction and it always occurs at the cathode.

blocks.prompt:
44 In the electrolysis of molten zinc chloride, the reaction at the anode is:
(Pighle hue zinc chloride ki electrolysis mein anode par kaun sa reaction hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Anions anode par electrons khote hain (oxidation): 2Cl⁻ → Cl₂(g) + 2e⁻; chlorine gas ki shakal mein banti hai (10.7, book correction).

book_ref.quote: Loss of electrons is oxidation. Oxidation always occurs at the anode.

blocks.prompt:
45 When H⁺ ions are discharged at the cathode, the product:
(Jab cathode par H⁺ ions discharge hote hain to product:)

options.text: metal ki teh ban kar jam jata hai
hydrogen gas hai jo bulbulon ki shakal mein nikalti hai
H⁻ ions ban kar ghul jata hai

blocks.explanation: 2H⁺ + 2e⁻ → H₂(g); hydrogen gas bane to bulbulon ki shakal mein nikal jati hai (10.7).

book_ref.quote: If hydrogen gas is formed, it bubbles off.

blocks.prompt:
46 The overall reaction for the electrolysis of molten ZnCl₂ is:
(Pighle hue ZnCl₂ ki electrolysis ka mukammal reaction kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Anode par khoye electrons cathode par hasil kiye electrons ke barabar hain, is se ZnCl₂(l) → Zn(s) + Cl₂(g) (10.7).

book_ref.quote: The electron loss at the anode balances the electron gain at the cathode.

blocks.prompt:
47 When molten copper(II) bromide is electrolyzed with inert electrodes, the product at the cathode is:
(Pighle hue copper(II) bromide ki inert electrodes se electrolysis mein cathode par kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cations (Cu²⁺) cathode ki taraf ja kar electrons lete hain: Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu; bromine anode par banti hai (10.7).

book_ref.quote: Molten copper (II) bromide (CuBr₂) is electrolyzed using inert electrodes.

blocks.text: 10.8 Mass of a substance deposited during electrolysis

blocks.prompt:
48 A current of 2.50 A flows for 10.0 minutes. The charge passed is:
(2.50 A current 10.0 minute tak guzarta hai. Kitna charge guzra?)

book_ref.quote: Combining current and time, we get the relationship:

blocks.prompt:
49 One Faraday is the quantity of electric charge carried by:
(Aik Faraday kitna charge hai?)

options.text: 1 mole protons aur neutrons ka charge

blocks.explanation: 1 Faraday 1 mole electrons (ya 1 mole aik charge wale ions) ka charge hai; is ki qeemat 96500 C mol⁻¹ hai (10.8).

book_ref.quote: Its value is 96500 C mol⁻¹.

blocks.prompt:
50 The mass of a substance produced at an electrode during electrolysis is proportional to:
(Electrolysis mein electrode par bannay wale substance ka mass kis ke mutanasib (proportional) hai?)
blocks.explanation: Banne wala mass guzarne wali bijli ki miqdaar (coulombs) ke mutanasib hai (10.8).

book_ref.quote: is proportional to the quantity of electricity (in coulombs) which passes through the electrolyte

blocks.prompt:
51 The charge needed to deposit 1 mole of copper from Cu²⁺ ions is:
(Cu²⁺ ions se 1 mole copper jamane ke liye kitna charge chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu ke liye 2 mol electrons, yaani 2 Faraday = 2 × 96500 = 193000 C (10.8).

book_ref.quote: So, it requires 2 Faradays of electricity (2 × 96500 C) to deposit 1 mole of copper.

blocks.prompt:
52 How many Faradays are needed to deposit 0.40 mol of aluminium from Al³⁺ ions?
(Al³⁺ ions se 0.40 mol aluminium jamane ke liye kitne Faraday chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Al³⁺ + 3e⁻ → Al; electrons ke moles = 3 × 0.40 = 1.2 mol, aur Faradays = electrons ke moles = 1.2 F (10.8).

book_ref.quote: 1 Faraday is the quantity of electric charge carried by 1 mole of electrons

blocks.prompt:
53 A charge of 965 C is passed through copper(II) sulfate solution. The mass of copper deposited is (Cu = 63.5 g mol⁻¹):
(Copper(II) sulfate solution mein se 965 C charge guzara gaya. Kitna copper jama hoga? (Cu = 63.5 g mol⁻¹))

book_ref.quote: 1 Faraday of electricity (96500 C) is required to deposit 1 mole of silver.

blocks.text: 10.9 Amount of substance produced during electrolysis

blocks.prompt:
54 A current of 0.250 A is passed through silver nitrate solution for 40.0 min. The mass of silver deposited is (Ag = 108 g mol⁻¹):
(Silver nitrate solution mein 0.250 A current 40.0 minute tak guzara gaya. Kitni silver jama hogi? (Ag = 108 g mol⁻¹))

book_ref.quote: The value of F can be used to calculate the mass of substance deposited at an electrode

blocks.prompt:
55 To deposit 1 mole of zinc from molten ZnCl₂, the charge required is:
(Pighle hue ZnCl₂ se 1 mole zinc jamane ke liye kitna charge chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Zn²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Zn: har mole Zn ke liye 2 mole electrons, yaani 2F = 193000 C mol⁻¹ (10.9).

book_ref.quote: Step 2 Find the number of coulombs required to deposit 1 mole of product at the electrode.

blocks.prompt:
56 Molten ZnCl₂ is electrolyzed with a current of 2.00 A for 25.0 min. The mass of zinc deposited is (Ar of Zn = 65):
(Pighle hue ZnCl₂ ki 2.00 A current se 25.0 minute tak electrolysis ki gayi. Kitna zinc jama hoga? (Zn ka Ar = 65))

book_ref.quote: Step 4 Calculate the mass by simple proportion using the relative atomic mass.

blocks.prompt:
57 Besides the mass of a metal deposited, the value of F can also be used to calculate:
(Jamne wali metal ke mass ke ilawa F ki qeemat se aur kya nikala ja sakta hai?)

options.text: electrode par bannay wali gas ka volume

blocks.explanation: F se electrode par jamne wala mass aur bannay wali gas ka volume nikala ja sakta hai (10.9).

book_ref.quote: the volume of gas produced at an electrode

blocks.text: 10.10 Avogadro's constant by the electrolytic method

blocks.prompt:
58 The Avogadro constant L can be found by electrolysis from:
(Electrolysis se Avogadro constant L kaise nikala jata hai?)

options.text: 1 mole electrons ka charge ÷ 1 electron ka charge
1 electron ka charge ÷ 1 mole electrons ka charge

blocks.explanation: L = 1 mole electrons ka charge / 1 electron ka charge (10.10).

book_ref.quote: The Avogadro constant, L, is the number of specified particles

blocks.prompt:
59 The charge on one electron, as used in the chapter, is approximately:
(Chapter ke mutabiq aik electron ka charge taqreeban kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tajurbat batate hain ke electron ka charge taqreeban 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C hai (10.10).

book_ref.quote: the charge on the electron is approximately 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C

blocks.prompt:
60 In the experiment to find the charge on 1 mole of electrons, the variable resistor is used to:
(1 mole electrons ka charge maloom karne ke tajurbe mein variable resistor kis liye hai?)
blocks.explanation: Variable resistor current ko taqreeban 0.2 A par constant rakhne ke liye hai (10.10.1).

book_ref.quote: The variable resistor is used to keep the current constant

blocks.prompt:
61 In this experiment the decrease in mass of the copper anode is used rather than the increase in mass of the cathode because:
(Is tajurbe mein cathode ke mass ke izafe ke bajaye copper anode ke mass ki kami kyun li jati hai?)

options.text: copper hamesha cathode par achhi tarah nahi chipakta

blocks.explanation: Anode ki kami is liye li jati hai ke copper hamesha cathode par achhi tarah chipakta nahi (10.10.1).

book_ref.quote: This is preferred because the copper does not always stick to the cathode very well.

blocks.prompt:
62 After electrolysis, the copper electrodes are washed and dried with distilled water and then with:
(Electrolysis ke baad copper electrodes ko distilled pani ke baad kis cheez se dho kar sukhaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Electrodes ko dobara tolne se pehle distilled pani aur phir propanone se dho kar sukhaya jata hai (10.10.1).

book_ref.quote: Remove the cathode and anode and wash and dry them with distilled water and then with propanone.
